IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Downloaded photos group by local capture date. EXIF Original/Digitized/DateTime
and supported offset tags are read on a separate local worker; missing or
invalid dates fall back to saved-file time. Raw metadata has a cancellable
canonical-path/length/mtime LRU cache capped at 4,096. JPEGs are not rewritten.
Date headers show counts and whole-day select/cancel; immutable grouping and
lazy row metadata support virtualized thumbnail rows with stable path selection.

Viewer trash and selected batch delete require explicit confirmation. Only
the App file, its corresponding system-gallery copy and project membership
are removed. Camera-card photos are retained; no camera write is issued.
Live, saving and preset-processing tasks exclude deletion. Per-item failure
retains the App source and reports retryable errors.
